name: Minen ⛏️
desc:
⛏️ Welcome to Minen ⛏️

Mine the ground to find all kinds of items, from junk to legendary treasures. Some have special mutations that make them more valuable. Upgrade your pickaxe, explore new regions, and grow your collection!

[How To Mine]
• Click to mine the ground
• Tap target spots to mine the item

Inspired by Fisch🦈
